text.p: Community First Bankshares Inc said CFB Capital I, a subsidiary, has begun an offering of 2.4 million 8-7/8 percent cumulative capital securities at an offering price of $25 per security.
The offering is being made through underwriters led by Piper Jaffray Inc and Dain Bosworth Inc.
It said the capital securities have been approved for listing on the Nasdaq National Market under the symbol "CFBXL."
The business trust subsidiary will use funds from the sale of capital securities to buy $60 million of 8-7/8 percent junior subordinated debentures of Community First.

Community First will use the net proceeds from the offering for corporate purposes, which may include possible future acquisitions, funding investments in, or extensions to, its subsidiaries, repayment of maturing obligations and redemption of securities.
